rawResults.Title: Windows AI | Microsoft Developer
rawResults.Snippet: Build powerful AI experiences with Windows AI APIs beyond Copilot+ PCs for the first time, now available in preview. From on-device language capabilities with Phi Silica on GPU to speech recognition and video super resolution on CPU, all with silicon-level integration, accelerate development with high-performance tools designed for modern applications.

rawResults.Title: Microsoft Unveils Aion 1.0 AI Models for Windows 11 - WinCentral
rawResults.Snippet: 4 days agoMicrosoft is taking another major step toward making Windows the premier platform for local AI development. At Build 2026, the company announced a new generation of on-device Small Language Models (SLMs), called Aion 1.0 Instruct and Aion 1.0 Plan, alongside a significant expansion of Windows AI APIs across CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs.

rawResults.Title: Build 2026: Furthering Windows as the trusted platform for development
rawResults.Snippet: 4 days agoWe are thrilled to share that Windows AI APIs are expanding beyond NPUs to CPUs and GPUs, bringing local AI experiences to a much broader set of Windows 11 devices.

rawResults.Title: Microsoft Expands Windows Local AI With New Aion Models and On-Device APIs
rawResults.Snippet: 4 days agoMicrosoft announced new Aion AI models, local speech APIs, and expanded Windows AI support for CPUs and GPUs.

rawResults.Title: Windows AI Models at Build 2026: Free On-Device Inference Is Now a ...
rawResults.Snippet: 3 days agoMicrosoft announced Aion 1.0 (a new on-device SLM family), expanded Windows AI APIs, WSL 3 NPU passthrough, and a Speech Recognition API at Build 2026. Free local inference on Copilot+ PCs is now a first-class Windows development target — no cloud dependency required.

rawResults.Title: Microsoft Build 2026: Windows Is Now an AI Agent Platform
rawResults.Snippet: 3 days agoAlongside the models, a new on-device Speech Recognition API enters public preview (English first), and existing Windows AI APIs expand beyond NPUs: the in-box SLM now runs on capable GPUs, and Video Super Resolution and Speech Recognition run on CPUs. 1 That matters because it extends local AI from the narrow slice of NPU-equipped Copilot+ PCs ...

rawResults.Title: Microsoft Aion 1.0: On-Device AI for Windows 11—Instruct, Plan, and New ...
rawResults.Snippet: 4 days agoMicrosoft announced Aion 1.0 Instruct and Aion 1.0 Plan at Build 2026 on June 2, positioning the new on-device small language models as part of a broader Windows 11 push to run AI workloads locally across CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs. The announcement is not just another model drop in a season full of AI branding.

rawResults.Title: Windows ML is generally available: Empowering developers to scale local ...
rawResults.Snippet: Sep 23, 2025First introduced at Build 2025, Windows ML is the built-in AI inferencing runtime optimized for on-device model inference and streamlined model dependency management across CPUs, GPUs and NPUs, serving as the foundation for Windows AI Foundry and utilized by Foundry Local to enable expanded silicon support which is being released today.
